anomalies.description: A man in the driver's seat is holding a handgun and pointing it forward; muzzle flash or bright light is visible near the barrel in frame f0, consistent with a discharge.; A visible muzzle flash and sparks erupt from the driver's side window of the pursuing vehicle as a gun is fired.; Sparks or muzzle flash are visible outside the passenger-side window in frame f1, indicating a shot was fired from inside the vehicle toward the exterior.
The lead SUV collides with the pursuing vehicle, causing visible deformation and a shower of sparks on impact.

A silver SUV is struck by a large front-end loader (bulldozer), causing the vehicle to be lifted and crushed against a pile of dirt/rock.
